one_minute_value_explanation: AOF can now look at the real GitHub repository in read-only mode and choose the next most important task with Japanese, evidence-backed reasoning and explicit no-write boundaries.
thirty_second_version_delta: v10.9 framed provider pilot readiness; v11.0 reads actual GitHub state and selects the next task without write authority.
product_review_trigger: If the operator still cannot understand why the selected task is most important, reopen product value explanation rather than claiming release success.
not_proven: This does not prove GitHub writes, productivity gain, semantic truth, or external adoption.
